title: Reading Drill — Watching pedestrian flow near a concert hall — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Watching pedestrian flow near a concert hall — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The venue manager in Bramley received an old report about audiences taking the same route as people waiting to enter. The report compared the number of conflicting queues, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the counts at the main doors rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered ten weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include performances ending early. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed a marked route for departures as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
